name: melody-fits-chords
about: Re-check: a melody read against the chords under it.

steps.say: write chords on track 7 in G major, then a melody on track 5 over them
are there any notes in the melody that clash with the chords?

name: faster-tempo-pad
about: Re-check: a tempo change re-checks a pad's slow attack.

steps.say: make an ambient pad loop with slow swelling chords on track 8 at 70 bpm
speed it up to 140

name: level-on-replica
about: Re-check: a level set on the replica, not with set_sound.

steps.say: make a beat with a bass
turn the bass down a little

name: merge-keeps-rolls
about: Re-check: a merge keeps the step components.

steps.say: make a beat with a snare roll at the end using multiply
change the hats to sixteenths, keep everything else

name: overwrite-name
about: Re-check: a save as onto a name already taken.

steps.say: make a beat and save it as demo
change the kick, then save it as demo again
make a UK garage 2-step beat with a bass
maak een rustige chill beat met akkoorden

name: modulate-up
about: A key change for the last part of a song.

steps.say: make a song with a verse and chorus, 4 bars each, with chords and a melody
add a final chorus a whole step higher
make a beat where a percussion line plays three against the four of the kick
